flawed_step: 0189: The claimed converse is false: Tor_0(C)=Tor_1(C)^⊥ and the correct cardinality do not imply that C is self-orthogonal.
counterexample: Over Z_4, let C=⟨(1,1)⟩⊆Z_4^2. Then Tor_0(C)=Tor_1(C)=⟨(1,1)⟩⊆F_2^2, so Tor_0(C)=Tor_1(C)^⊥, but (1,1)·(1,1)=2 mod 4, hence C is not self-dual. The same example also refutes Theorem 0286: its Gray image {0000,0011,1100,1111} is binary self-dual although C is not quaternary self-dual.
